package.name: sim_perception
package.description: Perception for the Isaac-only closed loop: SGBM stereo disparity node and YOLOX ONNX detector node, feeding TreeMapper (/disparity_image_down_float, /object_detection/detections). The detector needs onnxruntime (onnxruntime-gpu for CUDA), which is pip-installed, not a rosdep key.
